description.value: Capo and The Spritz is a neighbourhood Italian restaurant and cocktail bar occupying 120 seats within the Opus Hotel in Yaletown, blending handmade pasta and communal antipasti with an Italian-inspired aperitivo and cocktail program. The venue is divided into distinct spaces—a garden room, a main dining area, and the intimate 22-seat Spritz Bar—giving it a range of atmospheres from casual lunch to convivial evening feast. It sits just steps from the Yaletown-Roundhouse SkyTrain station along one of Vancouver's busiest cycling corridors.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: stands (3 spaces) at 69m; stands (3 spaces) at 71m. Total: 6 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and confirms Capo and The Spritz is an active Italian restaurant inside the Opus Hotel in Yaletown, Vancouver. The website corroborates the OSM address (350 Davie St) and supplies a phone number absent from OSM; UberEats and an 'Order' navigation link confirm takeout, and menu content confirms multiple vegetarian bowl and salad options. No bike parking, washroom, water refill, Wi-Fi, or other cycling amenities are mentioned anywhere on the site, so those fields are null per absence-of-evidence rules.
concerns: OSM has no phone number; website provides (604) 642-0557 — OSM should be updated.
OSM opening_hours (Mo-Su 15:00-22:00) appear significantly outdated; website shows full breakfast, lunch, and dinner service daily.
OSM name is 'Capo and the Spritz' (lowercase 'the'); website consistently renders it as 'Capo & The Spritz' — minor but worth standardizing in OSM.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active full-service Italian restaurant in Yaletown, a well-trafficked Vancouver cycling area; a practical meal stop for touring cyclists even without documented bike-specific infrastructure.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu lists multiple plant-based bowl options (Capo bowl with roasted yams, brown rice, kidney beans, and legumes; Ortolano bowl; Verde & Grano bowl) as well as salads and pasta dishes without meat
